name: Unblock the pull request queue
description: Read the open pull requests in the configured repositories, classify what each is waiting on, nudge the person whose turn it is, and post the daily digest. Follow the stored procedures 'How to work out what is blocking a pull request' and 'How to nudge without becoming noise'. Read the installation settings included with this run and honour 'repositories', 'digest_channel' and 'stale_after_days'. Use the working_days_since function for every age, so weekends never make a pull request look late.
response_policy: Nudges are direct messages; the digest is the only thing posted to the channel.
